companies.name: バイタル・ファームズ

relations.text: 自然食品店向けの多くをUNFIなどの食品卸経由で販売
relations.text_en: Sells to most natural channel customers through distributors such as UNFI

source.label: Vital Farms 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: We serve the majority of natural channel customers through food distributors, such as United Natural Foods, Inc., or UNFI

relations.text: 子会社Farmer Direct OrganicがUNFIと供給契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: Its Farmer Direct Organic Foods unit has a supplier agreement with UNFI

source.label: Above Food Ingredients 年次報告(20-F)(2024年提出)
source.quote: Supplier Agreement, between Farmer Direct Organic Foods Ltd. and United Natural Foods, Inc.

companies.name: アマゾン(ホールフーズ)
companies.sub: ネット通販・スーパー

relations.text: 最大の顧客Whole Foods Marketと2032年までの物流契約(売上の約28%)
relations.text_en: Distribution agreement through 2032 with Whole Foods Market, its largest customer (about 28% of sales)

source.label: United Natural Foods 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Amended and Restated Agreement for the Distribution of Products, dated May 21, 2024, between Whole Foods Market Services, Inc. and the Registrant

companies.name: ナチュラル・グローサーズ

relations.text: 仕入れの約69%(2025年度)をUNFIから調達する主要な卸
relations.text_en: Buys about 69% of its goods from UNFI, its primary distributor

source.label: Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: approximately 69% of our total purchases were from United Natural Foods Inc. and its subsidiaries (UNFI).

companies.name: スプラウツ・ファーマーズ・マーケット

relations.text: 二番手の仕入先としてUNFIから購入(仕入れの3%)
relations.text_en: Buys about 3% of its purchases through UNFI as its secondary supplier

source.label: Sprouts Farmers Market 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: Another 3% of our total purchases in each of fiscal 2024, 2023 and 2022 were made through our secondary supplier, United Natural Foods, Inc.

companies.name: スマート・フォー・ライフ

relations.text: Smart for Lifeが10-Kで、競合する卸としてUNFIを挙げる
relations.text_en: Smart for Life names UNFI among distributors it competes with

source.label: Smart For Life 10-K(2024年提出)
source.quote: We also compete with distributors that sell products to health stores as well as mass market retailers such as United Natural Foods and KeHE Distributors.

relations.text: JX Luxventureが年次報告で、競合の一社としてUNFIを挙げる
relations.text_en: JX Luxventure names UNFI among its competitors

source.label: JX Luxventure Group 年次報告(20-F)(2025年提出)
source.quote: Among our competitors are FASTENAL (NYSE:FAST), SYSCO (NYSE:SYY) and United Natural Foods (NASDAQ: UNFI).
